ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 dated 17 June 2020 (Articles 4, 29, 30, 31, 32, 33, 38, 39 and related); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP dated 4 January 2021 on Enterprise Registration (Articles 18-24 and Appendix II-2 concerning beneficial owner declaration); Circular No. 02/2021/TT-BKHDT dated 15 March 2021 on enterprise registration forms; Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 dated 14 November 2022, effective 1 December 2023 (Articles 4, 8-16, 19, 22); Decree No. 10/2023/ND-CP dated 15 April 2023 amending and supplementing Decree No. 116/2013/ND-CP; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN dated 28 December 2023 on AML/CFT for banks and non-bank financial institutions; Decision No. 21/2018/QĐ-TTg dated 12 May 2018 on the reporting and disclosure of beneficial owners of legal entities; Criminal Code 2015 (as amended 2017), Articles 324-326 on money laundering and terrorism financing.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, indirect investors, ultimate beneficial owners and legal representatives against the UN Security Council Consolidated List (1267/1988), OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, Vietnamese domestic lists of wanted persons and suspended enterprises, and global PEP registers. Enhanced due diligence is required under Article 16 of the Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 14/2022/QH15 for politically exposed persons (PEPs), high-risk sectors (ISIC 6499 – financial holding and blank-check acquisition vehicles), and clients from jurisdictions with identified anti-money laundering deficiencies. The compliance protocol must include automatic daily re-screening of all parties, risk scoring, negative news checks, source-of-funds verification, and escalation of any match through a dedicated AML/CFT compliance officer.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin Đăng ký doanh nghiệp Quốc gia) – dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The enterprise name must be expressed in the Vietnamese alphabet (chu Viet ngu) and must consist of two parts: the enterprise type (e.g., 'Công ty TNHH' for limited liability company) and the proper name. Proper names may include letters of the Vietnamese alphabet, Arabic numerals and certain symbols, but must not contain foreign script unless accompanied by an official Vietnamese transliteration. Latin-script foreign names may be transliterated into Vietnamese; a foreign abbreviation may be appended to the Vietnamese proper name only if the full Vietnamese transliteration is stated in the dossier. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an already registered enterprise name and must not contain words that violate the national cultural tradition or purport an affiliation with state authorities, political organisations or public entities.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Công an nhân dân (People's Public Security)
Cộng hòa xã hội chủ nghĩa (Socialist Republic)
Ngân hàng (Bank) – requires prior State Bank of Viet Nam approval
Bảo hiểm (Insurance) – requires prior Ministry of Finance / insurance supervisory approval
Chứng khoán (Securities) – requires prior State Securities Commission approval
Quỹ đầu tư (Investment fund) – requires prior securities and investment fund licence
Sở giao dịch (Exchange) – requires prior capital market regulatory approval
Tài chính (Finance) – used in a manner implying licensed financial intermediation may trigger statutory licensing review
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the absence of a formal name-reservation system, the applicant may alternatively proceed immediately to enterprise registration after a successful online query. If the DPI issues a written name rejection, the applicant may: (1) correct the name in the portal and resubmit a fresh application without prejudice; (2) file a written appeal with the Director of the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of the rejection response, setting out grounds that the chosen name is not identical or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise name and does not contain a prohibited token; (3) if the Director affirms the rejection, file a complaint with the Chairman of the Provincial People's Committee pursuant to the Law on Complaints (including an administrative appeal and, if necessary, a request for judicial review); and (4) initiate an administrative action before the competent provincial People's Court within one year from the date of the final administrative decision. A formal extension of the 30-day name-response window is not contemplated; however, the applicant may ask the DPI in writing for an expedited explanation if the decision is delayed beyond the statutory processing period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted as the sole registered office. A limited liability company in Viet Nam must maintain a physical head office within Vietnamese territory, evidenced by a valid lease, ownership title, or sublease contract and a physical nameplate / signboard. A licensed serviced or co-working office located in a registered commercial building is permissible, provided it has a dedicated address and a reception point for official documents and inspectors. Pure virtual offices, PO Box addresses, or remote mail-forwarding-only addresses are not accepted for enterprise registration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High – estimated 25% to 40% probability of an unannounced on-site inspection within the first 12 months of operation for a special-purpose acquisition vehicle classified as ISIC 6499. The provincial Department of Planning and Investment, tax authority, and State Bank of Viet Nam (if any payment or financial activity is conducted) may perform desk review and physical inspection to confirm commercial substance, UBO identification, payroll, accounting records and corporate records. Enhanced scrutiny applies to blank-check acquisition entities and financial holding vehicles due to elevated money laundering / shell-company risk.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Arts. 11, 22-24, 26-28, 31, 44-56, 73-79); Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14 (Arts. 6, 36-38, 43-44); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on Enterprise Registration (Arts. 4-6, 16-18, 21-27, 35-37); Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP implementing the Law on Investment (Arts. 3-12, 22-27); Circular No. 01/2021/TT-BKHDT; Circular No. 03/2016/TT-NHNN and Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN on foreign direct investment capital accounts; Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 155/2021/ND-CP (relevant conditioned financial service activities); Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 09/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the provincial/centrally-run city People's Committee (Business Registration Office and Investment Registration Division), or the Management Board of Industrial/Export Processing Zones/Economic Zones if the registered office is located within such zone; fully integrated through the National Enterprise Registration Portal and the National Investment Registration Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Combined statutory dossiers: (i) Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application dossier using Form A-I-1 under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP; and (ii) Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) application dossier using Form II-1 for a limited liability company under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP. The IRC authorizes the foreign-invested project and the ERC constitutes the legal incorporation instrument of the LLC.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum charter capital for a private limited liability company under Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (minimum_capital_requirement is false). The investor must, however, prove financial capacity for the investment project under Law on Investment Art. 36(2)(e) and Decree 31/2021/ND-CP Art. 24. If the vehicle is later categorized as a securities investment company or other licensed financial intermediary under the Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and Decree No. 155/2021/ND-CP, the legally-prescribed capital floor prescribed by the State Securities Commission applies. Charter capital must be fully paid within 90 days of ERC issuance (Law on Enterprises Art. 47(4)); SPAC proceeds must be segregated in a blocked escrow/trust account at a licensed commercial bank and released only for qualifying acquisitions, permitted fees, or pro-rata return to investors upon deal failure.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST MEETING OF MEMBERS OF [SPAC VIETNAM CO., LTD.] (A FOREIGN-INVESTED LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY TO BE INCORPORATED IN THE SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF VIETNAM)

THIS RESOLUTION is made on [____], 2026 by the founding member(s) of [SPAC VIETNAM CO., LTD.] (the 'Company').

WHEREAS:
A. The Company is to be formed as a foreign-invested limited liability company under Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14.
B. The Company's business scope is ISIC v4 6499 / NAICS 2022 525990, comprising a blank-check special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) for public-market acquisition mergers, funded through trust and escrow arrangements.
C. The founding member(s) have approved the draft Charter and these resolutions.

NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS RESOLVED THAT:
1. Capital Subscription. The initial charter capital is fixed at US$[____] (the 'Charter Capital'), divided into [____] capital contribution units subscribed as follows: [member names and subscription amounts]. Each member shall contribute its entire subscription in full within 90 days after the issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate by wire transfer to the Company's Direct Investment Capital Account at a licensed bank, in accordance with Circular 03/2016/TT-NHNN and Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN.
2. Registered Office. The Company's registered office (legal headquarters) is established at [address, ward, district, province/city, Vietnam]. The registered office shall be stated in the Enterprise Registration Certificate; any relocation shall be effected by amendment under Law on Enterprises Art. 31.
3. Appointment of Officers and Legal Representative. The following persons are appointed: (i) [Name, Passport No. ____] as Director and legal representative; (ii) [Name] as Chairman of the Members' Council (for a multi-member LLC); (iii) [Name] as Chief Financial Officer; and (iv) [Name] as AML Compliance Officer. Each officer accepts the duties imposed by the Law on Enterprises, the Company's Charter, and applicable anti-money laundering law.
4. Incorporation Filings. The Director and the appointed legal counsel are authorized to execute, notarize, and file the Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate dossiers with the Department of Planning and Investment, to pay all statutory fees, and to publish the enterprise registration contents on the National Enterprise Registration Portal.
5. Escrow and Trust. The Company shall open a segregated blocked escrow/trust account at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam or with the appointed custodian's correspondent bank. 100% of all SPAC offering proceeds remitted to or for the benefit of the Company shall be deposited into such account and held in trust, released only: (i) to fund a qualifying acquisition approved by the Members/Board; (ii) to pay permitted pre-approved SPAC fees; or (iii) for pro-rata return to investors upon failure of a qualifying acquisition. No release for general corporate purposes is permitted without the unanimous approval of the Members and the escrow agent.
6. AML and Governance. The Board shall adopt and implement AML/KYC policies, a beneficial ownership register, record-keeping procedures, and suspicious transaction reporting in compliance with Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 09/2022/QH15 and Decree No. 19/2023/ND-CP, and shall file all necessary notifications with the State Bank of Vietnam and the State Securities Commission.

This Resolution takes effect immediately upon signature by all founding members.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-incorporation Dossier Preparation, Legalization, and Notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vietnamese Notary Public Office (in the intended province/city), together with consular legalization / apostille authorities of the foreign founding member's home country.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) in Vietnamese and English, the investment project proposal, and the SPAC information memorandum; legalize and apostille the founding member's identification documents, certificate of incorporation, and certificate of good standing; prepare certified Vietnamese translations; execute the escrow/trust term sheet and pre-incorporation account mandate; have all founding members sign the Charter and statutory forms before the notary; obtain notarized copies of all constituent documents for submission to the DPI.
required_dossiers: Legalized/apostilled and notarized passport copies of each foreign individual member
Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing of the corporate founding member (legalized and certified-translated into Vietnamese)
Board resolution / owner resolution of the corporate founder authorizing establishment of the Vietnamese SPAC LLC and designating signatories
Notarized audited financial statements of the foreign corporate member (last two years) or a bank confirmation of financial capacity for the subscribed capital
Power of attorney appointing the local dossier submitter and counsel
Draft Company Charter in Vietnamese and English
SPAC offering memorandum / prospectus and escrow-trust term sheet
Proposed registered office address confirmation (lease MOU or landlord consent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary questions any translation or legalization element, correct the Vietnamese translation with a certified translation vendor and re-submit; if the apostille/consular legalization is defective, re-legalize through the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate or under the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; notarial refusal may be cured by attending a signature certification session in person before the notary with a sworn interpreter.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tong Cuc Thue) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; national e-tax portal: https://etax.gdt.gov.vn; enterprise registration and tax code issuance are integrated through the National Business Registration Portal: https://www.dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company must obtain a Vietnamese tax identification number (Ma So Thue) automatically upon enterprise registration. Procedure: (1) obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or an industrial-zone/export-processing-zone authority if the SPAC holds a conditional investment license; (2) file the enterprise registration dossier through the National Business Registration Portal to obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); (3) the tax code is issued simultaneously with the ERC and is also the enterprise code; (4) if the LLC also has foreign lender accounts, escrow/trust accounts or cross-border financing activities, a separate withholding tax registration for the account may be completed with the local tax office through e-tax; (5) register the authorized legal representative's electronic signature and bank account for e-tax filing/payment; (6) for VAT, the entity must register in the credit method and declare the tax period through the Tax Management System (TMS) within the statutory timelines.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The Vietnamese LLC is a resident corporate taxpayer taxed on worldwide income at the standard CIT rate of 20%. Territorial scope: resident entities are subject to CIT on Vietnam-source income and foreign-source income, with a foreign tax credit for taxes paid abroad. Tax-exempt zone eligibility: preferential zones include export processing zones (EPZs), industrial zones, hi-tech zones, and economically disadvantaged regions; eligibility for tax holidays, reduced rates (10% for 15 years, etc.), and import-duty exemptions may apply if the SPAC obtains an investment incentive certificate, but a pure SOAC holding entity generally has no manufacturing activity and must verify its incentive eligibility with the licensing authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not offer a U.S.-style check-the-box pass-through election; all LLCs are automatically entity-level CIT taxpayers. Available statutory elections include: (1) VAT calculation method election between the credit (deduction) method and the direct method, subject to conditions on revenue and accounting systems; (2) CIT incentive election via the investment registration process, selecting the applicable tax holiday/reduction regime; (3) five-year CIT loss carryforward election for offset against future profits; (4) foreign tax credit election for foreign-source income; (5) election to apply the Vietnamese transfer-pricing documentation of Decree 132/2020/ND-CP on an arm's-length basis; and (6) related-party interest expense limitation elections subject to thin-capitalization ratio. Hybrid mismatch elections generally are not recognized; a foreign investor's home-country classification of the LLC does not change its Vietnamese tax status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / Thue Gia Tri Gia Tang), governed by the Law on Value Added Tax, Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC and implementing decrees. Viet Nam has no separate GST or state-level sales tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VND 1 billion annual turnover for VAT registration of domestic production/trading activities. However, a foreign-invested LLC must register for VAT immediately upon enterprise registration, regardless of the threshold. In addition, cross-border e-commerce/digital service providers and foreign contractors performing services in Viet Nam are subject to VAT declaration through the foreign contractor tax regime (FCT), often without the VND 1 billion threshold. An SPAC LLC with no Vietnamese turnover is still required to maintain VAT registration while tax-exempt/zero-rated transactions are declared.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Viet Nam mandates 100% electronic invoicing since July 2022 for all enterprises, including foreign-invested LLCs. Invoices must be in XML format through the General Department of Taxation's e-invoice system. Real-time clearance applies mainly to sales to consumers at retail/POS: the invoice data must be transmitted to the tax authority's customer-facing system (TCTViet) via API before delivery of goods or completion of service, and a verification code (digital stamp) is required. Business-to-business transactions are subject to e-invoice transmission after issuance within 24 hours unless an offline transmission code is granted. The SPAC LLC must use an approved electronic invoice provider or the tax authority's free system; no paper invoices are permissible.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods are eligible for 0% VAT if they are physically exported outside Viet Nam and the export contract/customs declaration is consistent. Exported services also qualify when the service is consumed outside Viet Nam by a foreign customer, including offshore advisory, financial, or SPAC-related professional services, provided the service recipient has no permanent establishment in Viet Nam for the consumed service. Additional criteria: the export must be supported by a written contract, customs export declaration (for goods), foreign-currency remittance proof, and invoices; goods sold to duty-free shops or into export processing enterprises (EPEs) are also treated as export transactions for 0% VAT. The SPAC must avoid supplying domestic services to Vietnamese residential or local operating companies, as those services would be subject to 10% VAT and not zero-rated.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration) with cancellation/clearance status
Bill of Lading / Airwaybill evidencing physical export
Commercial invoice and signed sales/export contract
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit statement evidencing foreign-currency payment into a Vietnamese account
Electronic VAT invoice (export invoice) containing the 0% VAT rate
Packing list and certificate of origin (if required by the transaction)
Customs authority written confirmation of actual export, including EPE export liquidation reports where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False zero-rating or fictitious export claims are treated as VAT fraud and tax evasion. The tax authority may retrospectively claw back the 0% rate, impose 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount under the Tax Administration Law, charge overdue interest at 0.03% per day, and apply a fraud penalty up to VND 200 million for administrative violation. For criminal fraud, the Penal Code imposes imprisonment up to 3 years for evading VND 100 million or more, extending to 10 years for large-scale cross-border schemes. Exported goods not actually remitted within the FX deadline trigger a forced exchange-rate conversion and potential foreign-exchange administrative fine, and the VAT refund is withdrawn if the inward remittance certificate is later found invalid.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) - Foreign Exchange Management Department (FEMD), operating pursuant to the Law on the State Bank of Vietnam 2010, the Foreign Exchange Ordinance No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 (as amended by Ordinance No. 06/2013/UBTVQH13), and Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN, as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam maintains current-account convertibility for genuine trade in goods and services, including profit and dividend remittances, subject to documentation, tax clearance, and payment processing through an authorized foreign-exchange bank. Capital-account transactions are strictly controlled: an SPAC's inbound subscribed capital, escrowed proceeds, intra-company loans, and any downstream M&A disbursements must be routed through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) opened at a licensed commercial bank in Vietnam. Profit remittance requires an audited annual financial statement, completion of corporate income tax finalization, and issuance by the tax authority of a confirmation of completed tax obligations. Convertibility of Vietnamese dong on the capital account is not free; offshore derivative transactions referencing VND, including offshore NDFs, are prohibited outside SBV-regulated onshore channels. For a blank-check SPAC with no operating revenue, the operative hurdle is not profit remittance but the documented registration and filing requirements under the investment registration certificate (IRC) and the foreign-exchange regulations governing direct investment capital flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the current SBV regime, there is no mandatory conversion ratio for genuine export proceeds; an exporting entity may lawfully retain all export receipts in a foreign-currency account at an authorized bank in Vietnam. Export proceeds must be received into Vietnam in accordance with the payment terms of the underlying export contract, and where no shorter term is contractually fixed, are expected to be repatriated no later than 90 days from the date of shipment or from the due date established by commercial documents, as applicable. The exporter remains subject to customary documentary verification, SBV reporting, and prompt conversion at eligible market rates if it chooses to transfer to VND. Non-repatriation beyond the permitted period triggers administrative penalties, customs-consignment disputes, and foreign-exchange compliance sanctions under SBV guidelines.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.additional_fx_note: The SPAC itself is a special-purpose acquisition vehicle, not a goods-exporting enterprise; therefore its material FX exposure is inbound capital subscription flows, escrow deployment, and eventual cross-border acquisition purchase consideration, all of which require DICA registration and SBV-supervised banking channels.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA - Direct Investment Capital Account; FX Operating Account; SPAC Escrow/Trust Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA - Direct Investment Capital Account; Operational VND and FX Settlement Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: DICA - Direct Investment Capital Account; Operational VND/FX Account; LC Issuance Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational VND and Foreign-Currency Account; Corporate Payment Rail; Escrow Support Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low - legally constrained. Offshore digital EMIs, electronic banking platforms, and neobanks are not licensed as credit institutions in Vietnam, cannot hold VND-denominated accounts on behalf of a Vietnamese entity, and cannot act as custodians of a regulated Direct Investment Capital Account. Such platforms may be used only as ancillary treasury-tracking or multi-currency aggregation tools outside of Vietnam, while all lawful clearing and escrow must be executed through a locally licensed commercial bank or foreign bank branch authorized by the SBV. Use of an offshore EMI as the named settlement bank for inbound SPAC subscription proceeds is not compliant with Circular No. 15/2015/TT-NHNN and will be rejected by Vietnamese banking counterparties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A face-to-face KYC interview, or at minimum a bank-approved video KYC call followed by in-country physical verification of documents by a legal representative, is effectively mandatory for a foreign-invested SPAC/LLC. The bank will require at least one legal representative, normally the Vietnamese resident legal representative, to appear physically at the relationship-banking office; foreign directors and UBOs are generally required to sign powers of attorney before a local Vietnamese notary or consular office. Remote-only onboarding is permitted only in exceptional low-risk cases after enhanced due diligence, and even then the bank must verify the legal entity registration, IRC, charter, UBO chain, and source of funds via authenticated documents. For a medium-high risk SPAC with no operating history, the bank's compliance committee will insist on physical presence of the authorized signer or a formally appointed resident attorney-in-fact before account activation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SPAC/blank-check corporate nature with no tangible operating business, no revenue, and no identified acquisition target at onboarding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executive board resolution establishing the SPAC investment mandate; duly executed escrow agreement; approved private-placement memorandum or investment term sheet; formal letter from counsel describing the legal structure and the purpose of the bank relationship; detailed cash-flow forecast for the escrow account; corporate bylaws and certificate of incorporation with Vietnamese notarized translation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opaque, multi-layered overseas ownership and beneficial ownership chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SBV-compliant UBO declaration identifying all natural-person beneficial owners of 25% or greater; certified and legalized passport extracts and address proofs of all UBOs; full corporate-ownership chart through every intermediate holding entity, supported by current registry extracts and articles of incorporation from each jurisdiction; external legal opinion confirming no bearer shares or nominee ambiguity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound wires from diverse offshore investors with inconsistent sources of wealth and no auditable trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Subscription agreements signed by each investor; investor bank statements or letter of commitment issued by the remitting financial institution; source-of-wealth certification for each investor meeting the VN $100,000/USD screening threshold; sanction-screening reports; tax identification numbers of all natural or legal subscribers; anti-money laundering declarations in the bank's prescribed form.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Proposed inbound transfer from a high-risk jurisdiction, shell-bank arrangement, or FATF-monitored country
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written rationale for the jurisdiction's role in the corporate structure; negative sanctions and PEP-screening results; evidence of commercial purpose from the acquisition timeline; correspondent-bank reference from the originating regulated institution; legal analysis confirming that no designated person is a direct or indirect beneficial owner; enhanced due diligence undertaking to disclose all subsequent material changes.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear future deployment of escrowed public-market proceeds; heightened exposure to latent money-laundering through future acquisition payments
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IPO/SPAC placement agreement and prospectus summary; final escrow release conditions; board-approved acquisition policy including geographic and sector exclusions; AML/CFT compliance manual, sanctions policy, and client-risk classification policy of the SPAC; updated financial crime risk assessment; commitment to provide transaction-level reverse lookbacks and UBO refresh on counterparties at each drawdown.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound SPAC subscription and escrow proceeds must be routed by SWIFT MT103 (or equivalent electronic transfer) to the legal entity's registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank. The beneficiary must be the VN_LLC's full registered name and DICA number; the remittance instruction must contain, in field 70/72, the investment registration certificate reference, the direct-investment capital contribution purpose code, and the subscribing investor's legal name. The originating bank must pass the source of funds through to the Vietnamese bank's AML/CFT screening. The DICA is automatically segregated for capital accounting; proceeds must be matched against the approved capital contribution schedule and the foreign exchange registration granted by the SBV in connection with the IRC. No transfer may be netted or commingled with operational VND balances unless the bank has issued a formal conversion receipt.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For lawful operating expenditures and eventual acquisition target payments, the SPAC may instruct disbursements from its operational or DICA-linked account through SWIFT MT103 for standard cross-border transfers, MT202 COV for onward clearing, or a documentary commercial letter of credit (LC) where the bank issues a sight or usance LC against a generated commercial invoice. The bank will require underlying contracts, target-company purchase agreements, professional-fee invoices, or due-diligence support before each outbound wire. Payment to overseas target accounts must state the correspondent relationship in field 72, and the overall treasury rule is to route all outgoing trade and M&A payments through the same onshore authorized bank to preserve audit completeness and SBV reporting consistency.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: SBV-regulated onshore FX forward transaction with an authorized commercial bank, tenor matched to a documented commercial trade obligation or acquisition payment date
FX swap (spot sale/purchase of foreign currency combined with simultaneous forward purchase/sale) executed with a licensed onshore credit institution
Cross-currency swap (FX swap over a longer tenor) used only where there is a lawful underlying transaction such as cross-border acquisition financing or escrowed debt
FX option (vanilla European or American option) purchased from an authorized bank where the underlying exposure is evidenced by invoice, LC, or signed share-purchase agreement
Onshore permitted forward participation contracts and rate-smoothing arrangements under SBV Circular No. 02/2021/TT-NHNN and related guidance
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.default_clearing_protocol: Inbound and outbound liquidity must remain onshore; offshore netting arrangements and offshore NDF/derivative clearing referencing VND are not permissible. If the SPAC maintains overseas liquid reserves, those funds should be held at a reputable external financial institution solely as a treasury buffer, with all commercial settlement for Vietnamese direct investment routed back into the Vietnamese regulated banking system before use.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Operation Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động doanh nghiệp) including audited financial statements and member information
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; on or before 31 March for a calendar-year filer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of VND 5-20 million for late or inaccurate filing under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-filing may lead to forced dissolution and revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) finalization return and audited statutory financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Department of Taxation under the General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after tax year-end; no later than 30 March for a calendar-year filer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing fines of VND 4-25 million by delay band and late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on any unpaid CIT under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP and the Tax Administration Law 2019

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business license fee declaration and payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment interest at 0.03% per day and administrative fines up to VND 25 million; continued non-payment may enforce tax debt collection measures

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Securities Annual Report (annual disclosure for SPAC public-listing status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Securities Commission (SSC) and the relevant stock exchange
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after fiscal year-end under the Securities Law 2019; audited financial statements must be attached
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Disclosure fines up to VND 100 million under Decree 128/2021/ND-CP; repeated non-compliance can trigger listing suspension or delisting

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all foreign-invested enterprises (this VN LLC) regardless of size or revenue, and for public/listing company status; a SPAC escrow/trust balance and blank-check structure additionally requires an independent annual audit under Securities and AML requirements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnam Accounting Standards (VAS) for statutory filing; IFRS may be applied for SPAC public-listing purposes in accordance with Circular 11/2016/TT-BTC and the Ministry of Finance IFRS roadmap

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Membership/shareholding transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and submitted to DPI within 15 days of change; the annual DPI enterprise report serves as the annual confirmation of member/UBO structure. The AML Law 2022 further requires periodic beneficial-owner identification and KYC refresh, especially for SPAC escrow and trust funding sources.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Sổ đăng ký thành viên)
Register of Directors (Member's Council and General Director records)
Minute Book (meeting minutes, resolutions, and corporate decisions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: $300 - $800 per annum for registered office and corporate secretarial/legal agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: $10,000 - $25,000 per annum for a SPAC audit including escrow/trust and AML-complexity procedures

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT rate is 20%. Preferential rates of 10%, 15%, and 17% apply to qualifying high-tech, large-scale, or incentive-zone projects; SPAC holding and investment companies generally do not qualify for manufacturing incentives. Investment income and capital gains are subject to CIT at the standard 20% rate unless an applicable enterprise income tax incentive applies. No statutory tax holiday applies to a non-operating SPAC unless it obtains an investment certificate with specific incentives.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/DNT – Finalization Return for Corporate Income Tax (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN), submitted via the General Department of Taxation’s e-Tax portal (https://etax.gdt.gov.vn) or the National Public Service Portal; quarterly provisional CIT declarations are made via Form 01A/TNDN, Form 01B/TNDN, or Form 02/TNDN as applicable.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization, with quarterly provisional declarations and advance CIT payments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual CIT finalization return is due no later than the 90th day from the end of the fiscal year (i.e., by March 31 for a calendar-year taxpayer). Quarterly provisional CIT declarations are due by the 30th day of the first month following the end of each quarterly tax period; advance quarterly payments must not be less than 80% of the annual CIT liability calculated at year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box A – Identification (Mã số thuế / Tên người nộp thuế)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number, legal name of the enterprise, address, tax authority code, and fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-invested LLC must register with the local tax authority where its head office is located; include the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate numbers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from business activities, including sales of goods, services, interest income, and other operating revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a SPAC holding company, include interest income earned on trust or escrow accounts, dividends received (subject to exemption rules), and any gains from the disposal of investments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section II – Deductible Expenses (Các khoản chi được trừ)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct and administrative expenses properly supported by valid invoices and vouchers, including professional fees, audit fees, listing costs amortization, and business travel.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must comply with Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC and Circular 78/2014/TT-BTC; undocumented management fees or intra-group allocations must be rejected and adjusted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section III – Tax-Exempt Income (Thu nhập miễn thuế)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income items exempt from CIT, including income from domestic dividends received by a corporate shareholder and income from inter-company loans between related enterprises in Vietnam software/high-tech zones.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A SPAC entity may claim exemption only for cash dividends received from a Vietnamese joint-stock company that has already paid CIT; capital gains are not exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line A1 – Taxable Income (Thu nhập chịu thuế)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenue minus deductible expenses plus non-deductible adjustments and other taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute all Vietnamese-source income; foreign-source income is also taxable if the enterprise is resident in Vietnam, with foreign tax credits available.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line B – Loss Carryforward (Lỗ từ các năm trước chuyển sang)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward within 5 years, deducted against taxable income of the current period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: SPAC formation and IPO costs may not be deductible as a lump sum; capital losses on securities may only offset capital gains and unused losses expire after 5 years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line C – Tax Rate (Thuế suất thuế TNDN)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory rate 20%, or the applicable preferential rate evidenced by investment certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard 20% applies; no automatic preference for SPAC vehicles; any incentive rate requires prior approval in the Investment Registration Certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line D – Provisional Payments Reconciliation (Quyết toán thuế nộp tạm)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Comparison of total quarterly advance CIT payments with final annual CIT liability; shortfall exceeding 20% of the final liability attracts late payment interest at 0.03% per day.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the sum of quarterly payments equals at least 80% of final CIT; otherwise pay the difference plus late payment interest.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line E – Minimum Tax Top-Up / Supplementary CIT
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Any global minimum top-up tax under Pillar Two for groups with revenue above EUR 750 million, effective for fiscal years starting on or after 31 December 2024 under Resolution 107/2023/QH15.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-parented SPAC groups must assess Vietnamese constituent entity status and file Form for global minimum top-up tax if thresholds are met.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the finalization return attracts a fine of 2 million to 25 million VND (CIT) depending on the number of late days, plus 0.03% per day late-payment interest on unpaid tax. Incorrect declarations with understated tax attract a penalty of 20% of the understated amount plus interest; failure to file within 90 days after the due date while having tax payable may invoke tax assessment and enforcement measures, including bank account freezes.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Vietnamese limited liability company or joint-stock company to its corporate shareholder (resident or non-resident). However, a deemed profit distribution or interest paid to a foreign shareholder in a PIT treatment may be taxed at 5% – however, for corporate recipients under the CIT regime, dividends from Vietnamese entities are exempt from CIT and no dividend WHT applies under the Law on Corporate Income Tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Taxation Agreement (DTA), the non-resident shareholder must deliver a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the competent authority of the treaty country to the Vietnamese paying enterprise before payment or within 10 days after payment. The paying enterprise submits the TRC and a declaration form to the Vietnamese tax authority; the DTA must be claimed through the Vietnamese withholding agent using the mechanism under Circular 05/2016/TT-BTC and the OECD-recognized application procedure. Benefits are denied if the recipient lacks beneficial ownership or has no economic substance; for treaty countries, dividend rates are generally reduced from 0%/0% (since Vietnamese domestic law already exempts inter-corporate dividends) but for royalties and interest, treaty relief reduces rates from the statutory 10% to levels such as 5%, 10%, or 15% depending on the treaty.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory royalty WHT for foreign recipients is 10% (VAT+WHT combined regime under Law on Tax Administration and Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC: 10% WHT on royalty income). Statutory interest WHT for foreign lenders is 5% (WHT on interest). Under applicable DTAs, royalty WHT is often reduced to 5% or 10%, and interest WHT to 5% or 10%; for loans from related parties, arm's length interest and thin capitalization rules (30% EBITDA cap for interest expenses) apply. The SPAC trust interest paid to foreign investors generally is not subject to Vietnamese WHT because the income arises outside Vietnam unless deemed Vietnamese-source through investment capital.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File thresholds: enterprises with related-party transactions exceeding 30 billion VND in value and gross revenue exceeding 1 trillion VND in the fiscal year, or total related-party transactions above 30 billion VND, must prepare TP documentation (Form 01, 02, 03 under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP). SPAC entities engaged in transactions with foreign shareholders, management fees, or intragroup financing must prepare documentation if thresholds are met; even below thresholds, a Country-by-Country Report is mandatory for groups with consolidated revenue of at least 6.3 trillion VND.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam applies economic substance principles through the beneficial ownership test in DTA claims and through General Anti-Avoidance Rules (GAAR) under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP and Article 5 of the Law on Tax Administration. For SPACs, substance is critical to avoid treaty shopping, to maintain tax residence, and to prevent recharacterization of service fees as dividends. Vietnam does not currently apply sector-specific Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) in the manner of UAE, but the GAAR and DTA abuse provisions achieve a substance requirement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Under-declaration of Income (Trốn thuế)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Intentionally omitting trust interest income, capital gains, or related-party financing income from the CIT finalization return; using fictitious invoices or inflated management fees to reduce taxable income; submitting false TP documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty equal to 20% of the under-declared tax amount for ordinary errors; for intentional evasion, a penalty of 1 to 3 times the evaded tax amount plus late-payment interest. Violations above 100 million VND in evaded tax can trigger criminal prosecution under the Penal Code 2015 Article 200, with fines up to 4.5 billion VND or imprisonment up to 3 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives may be personally liable for tax debts of the enterprise if they intentionally fail to declare, debit accounts of the company, or dispose of assets; courts may order civil restitution of evaded taxes; criminal penalties extend to imprisonment for individuals; travel bans and exit suspensions are routinely imposed by Vietnamese tax authorities on legal representatives with outstanding tax debts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation (Quản lý giá chuyển nhượng)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form (Phụ lục III) with the annual CIT return; failure to prepare Local/Master File when related-party transactions exceed thresholds; using non-arm's length interest rates or management fees that shift profits to foreign related parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Re-determination of taxable income using the arm's length principle; penalty of 20% of the additional CIT assessed plus late-payment interest at 0.03%/day; administrative penalties for failure to file the TP form range from 4 million to 24 million VND; failure to provide documentation may lead the tax authority to apply the default profit mark-up method (2.5% to 5% mark-up on costs for distribution, 10% for manufacturing, 10% for services).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Legal representatives are required to sign and certify TP documentation; if false documentation is proven, the tax authority may pursue responsible individuals with restitution claims and penalize them under tax administration sanctions; guarantees or personal liability may be sought for unpaid liabilities on dissolution or transfer of the business.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Non-operational SPAC without Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Vietnamese LLC with no employees, no office, no bank accounts in Vietnam, no board meetings, solely to hold foreign investments or to claim treaty benefits on dividends or capital gains; failure to notify tax authority of inactive status; continuing to carry on business without a valid investment certificate or after license cancellation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax authority may reassess the entity as a sham, impose CIT on worldwide income without treaty protection, deny treaty benefits, impose fines for late filing, and revoke the Enterprise Registration Certificate; the Law on Enterprises permits forced dissolution and administrative fines up to 100 million VND for failure to report operations. Criminal liability for operating under a shell to commit financial fraud may apply under Penal Code Articles 174 (fraud) and 214.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for debts and tax liabilities if the shell is used to defraud creditors or tax authorities; the courts may pierce the corporate veil under Civil Code Article 90 and Enterprise Law; personal asset freeze, travel bans, and prohibition from leaving Vietnam apply to legal representatives of enterprises that fail to complete tax obligations before dissolution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Violations in Escrow / Trust Fund Handling
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: SPAC fails to conduct customer due diligence, fails to report suspicious transactions involving underwriters or SPAC shareholders, processes wire payments from unverified foreign investors through the Vietnamese bank account, or fails to maintain records of beneficial ownership of the escrow account under Decision 11/2023/QD-TTg.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under the Anti-Money Laundering Law 2022: from 30 million to 200 million VND for failure to report suspicious transactions; from 100 million to 300 million VND for serious license violations; the State Bank of Vietnam may suspend operations, revoke licenses, and institute criminal prosecution for money laundering under Penal Code Article 324, carrying imprisonment up to 15 years and fines up to 20 billion VND.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for AML compliance; they may be subject to criminal prosecution as accomplices if they knowingly allow the SPAC to launder proceeds; civil restitution of laundered funds and forfeiture of assets; travel bans and restrictions on departing the country may be imposed during investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax and DTA Abuse / Dividend Payments to Tax-Haven Lenders
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Making distributions described as loan interest to a related foreign lender at a rate above the arm's length threshold; failing to withhold WHT on interest paid to non-resident lenders (5%) or royalties (10%); claiming treaty relief without a valid TRC or on income enjoyed by a person without beneficial ownership.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Sanction: liability for unpaid withholding tax, penalty of 20% of withheld tax not remitted, plus late-payment interest at 0.03%/day; administrative fine for failure to withhold from 1-2 times the tax amount; disallowance of interest expense exceeding the thin capitalization cap of 30% EBITDA; penalty for violating the conditions for investment loans.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid withholding tax as withholding agents; criminal penalties up to 3 years' imprisonment for deliberate failure to collect or remit tax; travel bans and exit visas may be denied for the legal representative.
